title: Notify Fair Trading of a trade promotion gaming activity
summary: Find out how to notify NSW Fair Trading about a trade promotion gaming activity if the prize exceeds $10,000.
intro: If your proposed trade promotion has a prize that exceeds $10,000 you cannot start the promotion until:
who_can_apply: Proposed trade promotions with a prize exceeding $10,000
what_you_need: Access to the email or mobile number of the licensee or contact person who lodged the original trade promotion authority application
A clear description of the competition you are organising, including a copy of the gaming rules

how_to_steps.text: Gather the required information and documents.
Follow the prompts to submit your notification.

internal_links.text: Check the register of authorised community gaming and trade promotions

faqs.q: What is required if my trade promotion prize exceeds $10,000?
faqs.a: You cannot start the promotion until you notify Fair Trading.

faqs.q: What information do I need to notify Fair Trading?
faqs.a: You need your 6-digit trade promotion authority number, access to the email or mobile number of the licensee or contact person, and a clear description of the competition including a copy of the gaming rules.

faqs.q: How do I notify Fair Trading about my trade promotion?
faqs.a: Gather the required information and documents, select the 'Notify online' button, and follow the prompts to submit your notification.
